note: How to play, per beat of each run (runs.json beats). Shown on the briefing before a beat and on the H help overlay; each step's `prompts` are the station's prompt keys (stations/<id>.json runs.<n>.prompts, or map.json for "map"), so the HUD's step dots advance as the prompts change. UI text only: no numbers or claims beyond what the station data already shows.

briefing.title: Waste to Wealth
briefing.tagline: One kilo of meat waste in Shivajinagar

s01.goal: Finish the morning cut and bag the waste.

steps.label: Chop
steps.text: Press as the ring round the block draws in tight for a clean cut. Three chops.

steps.label: Pick up
steps.text: Lift the bag of bone and offal off the counter. Watch its tag.

steps.label: Walk on
steps.text: Head out with the kilo.

s02.goal: Carry the kilo to the back of Russell Market.

steps.label: Walk
steps.text: Arrows or WASD to walk, or hold the mouse where you want to go. Let the handcart pass.

steps.label: Drop it
steps.text: Leave the bag on the pile behind the market.

steps.label: Head back
steps.text: Walk back to the stall.

s01:night.goal: That night, the power goes out.

steps.label: Watch
steps.text: No power, no cold. Watch the leftover meat on the counter.

steps.label: Next day
steps.text: Start the same day again, this time with the hub.

map.goal: See the same morning across the whole market.
map.tip: 1 · 2 · 3 switch the map lens: waste, money, power.

steps.label: Watch
steps.text: Every stall's waste heads for its nearest dump.

steps.label: Clear piles
steps.text: Click a pile to clear it, then watch it come back.

steps.label: Move on
steps.text: Play the same day with the hub.

s01.goal: Finish the morning cut and bag the waste.

steps.label: Chop
steps.text: Press as the ring round the block draws in tight for a clean cut. Three chops.

steps.label: Pick up
steps.text: Lift the bag of bone and offal off the counter.

steps.label: Walk on
steps.text: Take it to the hub this time.

s02.goal: Carry the kilo down the street to the hub.

steps.label: Walk
steps.text: Arrows or WASD to walk, or hold the mouse where you want to go. Let the handcart pass.

steps.label: Into the hub
steps.text: Step in at the hub's drop window.

s03.goal: Sort the kilo, weigh it and get paid.

steps.label: Sort
steps.text: Meat waste into the crate (←), rubbish into the bin (→). Rubbish in the crate makes it a mixed crate.

steps.label: Weigh
steps.text: Drag the crate onto the scale.

steps.label: Get paid
steps.text: Chat with the attendant: Space for each line. Listen for the payment and watch the tag.

steps.label: Move on
steps.text: Into the cold room.

s04.goal: Keep everything cold, even through a power cut.

steps.label: Chamber B
steps.text: Drag the sealed crate into Chamber B.

steps.label: Chamber A
steps.text: Drag the unsold meat into Chamber A.

steps.label: Power cut
steps.text: Watch the evening: the grid goes, the hub stays on its own solar.

steps.label: Move on
steps.text: To the pickup bay.

s05.goal: Load the hub's crates onto the collector's truck.

steps.label: Load
steps.text: Each press loads one crate. Yours goes in last.

steps.label: Follow
steps.text: Follow the crate off-site.

s06.goal: Run the kilo through the renderer, machine by machine.

steps.label: Process
steps.text: Each press sends it through the next machine. The strip at the top shows the stage.

steps.label: See it used
steps.text: Follow the product to where it is used.

s07.goal: See the meal put to use on a farm.

steps.label: Hens
steps.text: Feed the hens from the scoop.

steps.label: Soil
steps.text: Scatter it on the vegetable beds.

steps.label: Ledger
steps.text: See the day's ledger.

map.goal: Play the same market with the hub.
map.tip: 1 · 2 · 3 switch the map lens: waste, money, power.

steps.label: Open
steps.text: Open the hub's drop window.

steps.label: Watch
steps.text: Stalls drop inside the window, one pickup serves the market, and the loop comes back.

steps.label: Ledger
steps.text: See the day's ledger.
